title: theme
description: Look of the whole shell: light/dark/OLED mode, fonts, roundness, animation speed, shadows and the surface variants (sr*: background, popup, bar, pane, focus, primary, ...) every container is drawn with.

oledMode.title: Oled mode

x-settings.label: prefs.appearance.mode
x-settings.keywords: dark light oled amoled black night day

oledMode.description: Pure black backgrounds (dark mode only); good for OLED panels.

lightMode.title: Light mode

x-settings.label: prefs.appearance.mode
x-settings.keywords: dark light oled amoled black night day

lightMode.description: Use the light variant of the generated palette.

roundness.title: Roundness
roundness.description: Corner radius of panels, buttons and islands.

x-settings.label: settings.theme.roundness
x-settings.keywords: radius corners rounded square shape

font.title: UI Font
font.description: Used for all text in the shell.

x-settings.label: settings.theme.ui_font
x-settings.keywords: font typeface family text size typography

fontSize.title: Font size

x-settings.label: settings.theme.ui_font
x-settings.keywords: font typeface family text size typography

fontSize.description: Base UI font size; other sizes scale from it.

monoFont.title: Mono Font
monoFont.description: Used for code, paths and the terminal theme.

x-settings.label: settings.theme.mono_font
x-settings.keywords: monospace code terminal font typeface

x-settings.label: settings.theme.mono_font
x-settings.keywords: monospace code terminal font typeface

tintIcons.title: Tint Icons
tintIcons.description: Recolor app icons with the palette.

x-settings.label: settings.theme.tint_icons
x-settings.keywords: icons monochrome tint color

enableCorners.title: Enable Corners
enableCorners.description: Round the corners of the screen.

x-settings.label: settings.theme.enable_corners
x-settings.keywords: screen corners rounded display edges

animDuration.title: Animation
animDuration.description: Speed of every animation. Off disables them.

x-settings.label: settings.theme.animation
x-settings.keywords: animation speed duration fast slow motion reduce

paletteTransitionDuration.title: Color Fade
paletteTransitionDuration.description: How long colors blend when the palette changes.

x-settings.label: settings.theme.palette_transition
x-settings.keywords: palette colors crossfade fade wallpaper change transition

shadowOpacity.title: Shadow opacity
shadowOpacity.description: Opacity of the shadow under shell surfaces.

shadowColor.title: Shadow color
shadowColor.description: Shadow color. Color spec: a palette role (e.g. "primary", "surface", "overBackground"), "#rrggbb"/"#aarrggbb", or either with an alpha suffix ("surface@0.5").

terminalOpacity.title: Background opacity
terminalOpacity.description: Kitty's background opacity before glass. From preset follows the preset's background surface.

x-settings.label: prefs.term.opacity
x-settings.keywords: kitty terminal opacity transparency background alpha

surfaceEffect.title: Effect
surfaceEffect.description: A signature texture on the shell's own surfaces (bar, notch, launcher, popups, settings). App windows are never touched.

x-settings.label: prefs.effects.effect
x-settings.keywords: surface effect texture crt scanlines retro phosphor vignette ink sumi-e paper grain brush

surfaceEffectOptions.title: Surface effect options
surfaceEffectOptions.description: Options of the surface effect (each effect reads the ones it uses).

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: How strong the effect is. Lowered automatically when text would become hard to read.

x-settings.label: prefs.effects.intensity
x-settings.keywords: effect intensity strength amount

flicker.title: Power-on flicker
flicker.description: A short phosphor flicker when a surface appears (off when animations are off).

x-settings.label: prefs.effects.flicker
x-settings.keywords: crt flicker power on phosphor

grain.title: Paper grain
grain.description: Rice-paper texture; full on light surfaces, faint on dark ones.

x-settings.label: prefs.effects.grain
x-settings.keywords: ink paper grain texture rice paper

brushHighlights.title: Brush-stroke highlights
brushHighlights.description: Paint selections, focus and active pills as ink brush strokes.

x-settings.label: prefs.effects.brush_highlights
x-settings.keywords: ink brush stroke highlight selection focus sumi-e

glass.title: Glass
glass.description: Glass system (modules/theme/GlassModel.js): one master amount makes every surface more or less glassy; -1 anywhere means inherit/auto.

enabled.title: Glass effect
enabled.description: Translucent, blurred surfaces across the shell, windows and terminal. Off makes everything solid.

x-settings.label: prefs.glass.enabled
x-settings.keywords: glass glassy blur transparency translucent frosted acrylic mica liquid see-through solid opaque

amount.title: Glassiness
amount.description: One slider for everything: 0% is solid, 50% tasteful frosted glass, 100% very glassy. Text always stays readable (WCAG 4.5:1 on any wallpaper).

x-settings.label: prefs.glass.amount
x-settings.keywords: glass amount glassiness blur transparency translucent frosted more less slider

referenceAmount.title: Reference amount
referenceAmount.description: Amount at which the preset shows its designed values; -1 = derived from the preset's sr*/terminal opacities.

tintRole.title: Tint color
tintRole.description: Palette role used to tint the glass.

x-settings.label: prefs.glass.tint_role
x-settings.keywords: glass tint color role accent

highlightRole.title: Highlight color
highlightRole.description: Palette role of the top-edge highlight.

x-settings.label: prefs.glass.highlight_role
x-settings.keywords: glass highlight edge color role

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Advanced overrides of single glass properties; -1 = follow the master amount.

opacity.title: Surface opacity
opacity.description: Fixed opacity for every glass surface instead of the curve (still clamped for legibility).

x-settings.label: prefs.glass.opacity
x-settings.keywords: glass opacity transparency translucent alpha see-through

blurSize.title: Blur size
blurSize.description: Compositor blur radius behind windows and shell surfaces.

x-settings.label: prefs.glass.blur_size
x-settings.keywords: glass blur size radius frosted

blurPasses.title: Blur passes
blurPasses.description: More passes give a smoother, stronger blur (costs GPU).

x-settings.label: prefs.glass.blur_passes
x-settings.keywords: glass blur passes quality strength

vibrancy.title: Vibrancy
vibrancy.description: Saturation boost of the colors seen through the glass.

x-settings.label: prefs.glass.vibrancy
x-settings.keywords: glass vibrancy saturation color pop

noise.title: Noise
noise.description: Fine grain on the blur, avoids banding.

x-settings.label: prefs.glass.noise
x-settings.keywords: glass noise grain texture

x-settings.label: prefs.glass.contrast
x-settings.keywords: glass contrast backdrop

brightness.title: Backdrop brightness
brightness.description: Dims (dark themes) or lifts (light themes) the blurred backdrop.

x-settings.label: prefs.glass.brightness
x-settings.keywords: glass brightness backdrop dim

tintStrength.title: Tint
tintStrength.description: How much the palette tint color washes over glass surfaces.

x-settings.label: prefs.glass.tint_strength
x-settings.keywords: glass tint color accent wash

borderHighlight.title: Edge highlight
borderHighlight.description: A thin light line along the top edge of glass panels.

x-settings.label: prefs.glass.border_highlight
x-settings.keywords: glass highlight edge rim light line border shine

shadowSoftness.title: Shadow softness
shadowSoftness.description: Wider, softer shadows under glass surfaces and windows.

x-settings.label: prefs.glass.shadow_softness
x-settings.keywords: glass shadow soft blur depth
